title: The Limits of Agreement — Part-Time Legislators Passing Laws
description: The Fischer, Lynch, and Paterson impossibility result: part-time legislators in the Chamber of Paxos, messengers crossing the floor, and why no deterministic voting rule can guarantee that any decree ever passes.
question: Can machines always agree when one of them may stop silently and messages take any time at all?
how: We find out by exploring how four part-time legislators in the Chamber of Paxos, sending messengers across the checkerboard floor and olive groves, tried to pass a decree when any of them might have departed.

papers.authors: Michael J. Fischer, Nancy A. Lynch and Michael S. Paterson
papers.title: Impossibility of Distributed Consensus with One Faulty Process
